text: Chapter 10: The Lost God's Ship@The Inhabitants Under the Cliff
There is a road under the cliff of Lunagent and something is\nclearly seen coming and going. Follow the road and find out\nwhat Pelulu saw!
The Inje people who illegally inhabit the area under the\ncliff can't abandon the children that are being attacked by\na monster. Head to Ducia Coast to rescue them!
The children seem to be at the depths of the coast.\nGet there as soon as possible!
A giant fish monster, Pisteus, is still\ntrying to attack the children!\nJoin forces with the Injes to defeat it!
